facts.name: The Berk on College
facts.address: Heart of Berkeley, Steps From the Classroom
facts.notes: Offers co-living communities with professional weekly cleaning in communal areas, super-fast fiber-optic WiFi, 24/7 maintenance & management, onsite washers and dryers, and state-of-the-art kitchen appliances. Residents can use an app to pay rent/submit maintenance requests/download lease.
